datasets.name: CreditCards
datasets.sql:
select id from cm_active_credits 
                where CM_CARDS.iscreditcards(id)=1 and CM_CARDS.Get_CustOstat(id)<0

datasets.name: Transactions
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   A.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo, 
   D.VAL_NAME as DebitCurrency, 
   C.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo, 
   T.Ostat,
   E.VAL_NAME  as CreditCurrency,
   B.TRDATE ,
   B.CANPROCESS , 
   B.INBALANCECHAR , 
   B.FLAGS , 
   B.DEBITAMOUNT , 
   B.CREDITAMOUNT , 
   B.NATAMOUNT ,
   B.TrDescription
FROM
   ACCOUNT A
 , AVALUTE D
 , CM_TRANSACTIONS B
 , ACCOUNT C
 , AVALUTE E
 ,TENOSTAT T
WHERE
     (B.DEBITACCID = A.ID)
 AND (D.VALUTE = A.VAL_ACC)
 AND (B.CREDITACCID = C.ID)
 AND (C.VAL_ACC = E.VALUTE)
 and (T.ACC_ID = B.CREDITACCID)


union 

SELECT
   A.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo, 
   D.VAL_NAME as DebitCurrency, 
   C.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo, 
   T.Ostat,
   E.VAL_NAME  as CreditCurrency,
   B.TRDATE ,
   B.CANPROCESS , 
   B.INBALANCECHAR , 
   B.FLAGS , 
   B.DEBITAMOUNT , 
   B.CREDITAMOUNT , 
   B.NATAMOUNT ,
   B.TrDescription
FROM
   OUT_ACCOUNT A
 , AVALUTE D
 , CM_TRANSACTIONS B
 ,OUT_ACCOUNT C
 , AVALUTE E
 ,smart.out_TENOSTAT T
WHERE
     (B.DEBITACCID = A.ID)
 AND (D.VALUTE = A.VAL_ACC)
 AND (B.CREDITACCID = C.ID)
 AND (C.VAL_ACC = E.VALUTE)
 and (T.ACC_ID = B.CREDITACCID)

datasets.name: Controls
datasets.sql:
select p.numberofcredit,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get(a.contractaccid) as contractno,
       cm_common.accountrest_get(a.booroweraccid) as CustRest,
       h.rest 
from cm_active_credits p,
     cm_accounts a,
     cm_curr_state h
where p.id = a.creditid
and   p.id=h.creditid 
and   cm_common.accountrest_get(a.booroweraccid)<0

datasets.name: Branches
datasets.sql:
select -1 as id,'Bütün filiallar' as name from dual
union
select id ,name from filial
order by id
